meta.source: Design canvas https://claude.ai/artifact/UAf7RoHQDn82UNjNBzRCSE, rows B Watch refined and Operator screens in B, approved by Franco Megannon 2026-10-21

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind lists, forms and the map.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Header, tab bar, sheets, cards and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Selected rows and the active tab ground in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and icons on bg and surface. 16.8:1 light, 16.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: places, labels, legends. 6.7:1 on bg light, 8.2:1 on surface dark.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows. Decorative only, never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Edge of inputs, selects, outline buttons and the watch strip. 3.4:1 on bg light, 3.9:1 on surface dark (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: One primary action per screen, the Now marker on the watch strip, focus ring. 5.8:1 on bg light, 9.6:1 on bg dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent buttons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected option fill and the privacy guard ground.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft: guard warnings, near-repeat notes, searching status. 8.1:1 light, 9.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px outline, 2px offset, on every focused control.

tokens.name: saved-ink
tokens.usage: Saved chip and cleared sectors, always with a check icon.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error message ground and the Active operation chip.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Text on error-bg. 8.0:1 light, 10.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: error-line
tokens.usage: Border of an invalid input or an active operation card.

tokens.name: family-breakin
tokens.usage: Break-ins, drawn as a square. Never colour alone.

tokens.name: family-suspicious
tokens.usage: Suspicious activity and LPR alerts, drawn as a circle.

tokens.name: family-vehicle
tokens.usage: Vehicle crime, drawn as a triangle.

tokens.name: map-sea
tokens.usage: Sea on the base map.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Land on the base map.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Minor roads.

tokens.name: map-road-major
tokens.usage: The N2 and main roads.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Suburb names on the map, sentence case.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen title on detail and operation screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two people in dark clothing seen checking car doors.
styles.usage: Report text, inputs and buttons. 16px stops phones zooming into inputs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Legends, attribution, tab labels. Smallest size used.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Times in the fixed time column, 24-hour.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Elapsed time of an active operation.

styles.name: grade
styles.usage: Source grade badges and counts. Mono only for times, grades and counts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between a shape and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and list items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and field padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter and section gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Computer side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large gaps on sign-in.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Grade badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chips and the watch strip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the sheet under the map.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between control and focus ring.
